question: After freezing the actual lane's effective curve baseline and recording prewarm trigger provenance, can every same-path executed-entry mismatch be assigned by a deterministic pre-registered priority to baseline control, wallet identity coverage, sniper anchor definition, or residual provider state?

methodologyBoundary.reason: V9 recomputed the shadow short-window curve baseline from shared history after the actual row was appended, so four of six historical same-path entry mismatches were contaminated by a comparator control defect.

classifierEpoch.primaryCauseSelection: First matching cause in the frozen causePriority list.
classifierEpoch.contributingCausePolicy: Record every detected contributing cause even when only one primary cause grades attribution.

baselineControl.selectedInvariant: For selected baselines, shadowBaselineAnchorHeldConstant is true and both anchor and curve-progress skew equal exactly zero.
baselineControl.unselectedInvariant: For a valid frozen no-baseline control, shadowBaselineAnchorHeldConstant is true, baselineControlSelected is false, and both skew fields are null.
baselineControl.actualTelemetryAgreementRole: actualBaselineMatchesControl remains a separate telemetry-consistency diagnostic and is not substituted for the shadow control invariant.
baselineControl.historicalFieldAbsenceTreatment: Pre-V10 rows lacking the invariant fields are historical fields-absent, never baseline mismatches.

prewarmDiagnostics.firstTriggerPolicy: The first prewarm timestamp, primary trigger, and trigger set are immutable. Duplicate prewarm observations are counted and may add seen-trigger diagnostics but do not extend TTL or rewrite the first trigger.
prewarmDiagnostics.candidateUpgradePolicy: A comparison request records the first comparison timestamp and distinguishes a prewarm upgrade from a direct comparison subscription.

entryMismatchAttribution.passRule: At least one comparable same-path executed ENTRY and one same-path mismatch must be observed. Every mismatch must have one deterministic allowed primary cause. All contributing causes remain visible, and zero mismatches or cross-path-only samples are insufficient evidence.
entryMismatchAttribution.walletIdentityDefinition: A wallet feature disagreement or uniqueBuyerCount/capture disagreement is wallet identity coverage; correlated score differences remain visible as contributing residual state but do not outrank the wallet cause.
entryMismatchAttribution.sniperAnchorDefinition: A sniper count/capture disagreement plus a sniper source, first-reference anchor kind, anchor timestamp, anchored flag, or window-length disagreement is a sniper anchor-definition mismatch. Provenance-only differences are non-causal diagnostics; count differences without anchor-provenance disagreement remain residual provider state.
entryMismatchAttribution.residualDefinition: Any remaining causal market or guard input difference not assigned to wallet identity or a demonstrated sniper-anchor definition difference.
entryMismatchAttribution.positionStatePolicy: Use actual pre-observation position context as a held-constant control.
entryMismatchAttribution.guardPathPolicy: Different selected guard-override families are scope-incomparable and excluded before attribution.

freezePolicy.note: V10 begins a fresh evidence epoch. Historical V9 mismatches cannot be relabeled or counted.

nextIfPass: Keep Helius report-only and repeat under the unchanged V10 contract before proposing provider routing or strategy consumption.
nextIfFail: Fix only the demonstrated V10 instrumentation defect. Do not change strategy, freshness bounds, gates, exits, capacity, or provider routing.
